title: PreCare: Designing AI Assistants for Advance Care Planning (ACP) to Enhance Personal Value Exploration, Patient Knowledge, and Decisional Confidence
reasoning: The paper focuses on the design and user evaluation of an AI-driven tool (PreCare) for medical Advance Care Planning (ACP). Although the application domain (end-of-life decisions) involves personal values, the research is an HCI and clinical application study evaluating usability, knowledge gain, and decisional confidence, rather than a benchmark or evaluation of moral, ethical, or religious reasoning.
